derivation: from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and the alternate form of G1632 (ἐκχέω);
def: to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow

occurrences.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
